32.description: This feature vector represents common Italian and multilingual lexical roots, grammatical suffixes, and common nouns.

136.description: This vector represents common Italian grammatical elements, pronouns, and prepositions.

190.description: This vector represents common Italian grammatical words and everyday adverbs.

135.description: This feature vector represents human beings, including words for men, women, and people across different languages.

172.description: This vector represents suffixes and roots associated with capability, possibility, and feasibility across Romance languages.

106.description: These tokens represent prepositions and contracted preposition-article combinations in Romance languages, primarily Italian and French, expressing origin, possession, or agency (such as "of", "from", and "by").

90.description: This feature vector activates strongly for words, roots, and sub-word tokens related to robots, robotics, and automation technology.

129.description: The tokens represent subword units, suffixes, or root fragments related to the Latin-derived root "pul-" meaning push or drive, commonly found in words like pulse, impulse, and pulsation.

176.description: This vector activates on common Italian and Portuguese verb roots, prefixes, and morphologic stems.

134.description: This vector activates on tokens containing or related to the Greek-derived prefix "auto-" meaning self or automatic.
